title: Square emblem ring wearing our animated textures
desc: J's four square emblem rings (P01-P04) each shown in five of the animated construct textures (ripples, weave, hex), spinning on a turntable.

takes.name: Faithful plus - X5 ripple emerald
takes.facts: square emblem ring P01 (Faithful plus) wearing X5 ripple emerald on every green cell, animated 32 frames x 5 ticks, one tile per 4 model px; lights up frames 20-44; turntable one turn per 200 frames
takes.cam3p: Cam P01 X5E Faithful plus - X5 ripple emerald
